content_en: From viral side project to five million B2B AI platform. Have you ever because internship did not convert but achieved bigger career. Yasser Elsaid experienced. He interned at Meta did not get return offer. Then what. Two years later his Chatbase achieved five million ARR. Serving nine thousand plus active subscribers. Unexpected viral spread. February twenty twenty three Yasser in final year of university full schedule. He did not get return offer from Meta internship hindsight is best thing happened to him. He was inspired by some big names in independent entrepreneurship space entering AI like Pieter Levels. Then he started exploring how to build useful tools using OpenAI API. Chatbase idea started as ChatGPT for your PDFs simple tool letting users upload documents and chat with their content. He posted tweet to his sixteen followers to his surprise it went viral. He realized he hit something with huge potential within weeks he decided to make Chatbase full time focus.
content_jp: バイラルサイドプロジェクトから500万B2B AIプラットフォームへ.实习が转换らなかったのにより大きなキャリア成就したことがありますか?Yasser Elsaidは経験した.Metaで实习return offer没有得到.那么什么.2年後彼Chatbaseは500万ARRを達成.9000人以上のアクティブな 加入者を持つ.予期せぬバイラル传播.2023年2月Yasserは大学の最終年で满满.他没有从Meta实习拿到return offer后见之明是发生在身上的最好的こと.彼は独立起業界のいくつかのbig namesがAIに入ることに触発された比如Pieter Levels.然后他开始探索如何用OpenAIのAPI构建有用的工具.Chatbase的想法始于ChatGPT for your PDFs简单工具让用户上传文档并与其内容聊天.他发了一条推给他16个粉丝令他惊讶的是它病毒式传播了.彼は巨大的潜力を持つものに気づき数週間以内にChatbaseに全职で聚焦することを決定した.
